verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS identity platform with an admin dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows an official MCP server that lets external AI tools like Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf manage the tenant "without touching the dashboard", plus SDKs for securing customers' own agents. Neither is an assistant built into the product, and nothing in the pack documents an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to.
